messages.subject: Quantile regression in lavaan?
parts:
I have some growth data that is clearly "wedge-shaped", meaning that most trajectories are relatively flat, but that some increase more steeply as time goes by. It looks roughly like this:
https://www.unc.edu/courses/2007spring/biol/145/001/gifs/lab10/scatter15.png

One way to deal with this kind of data is to use a quantile regression, e.g. using `quantreg` in R. 

Is there a way to use quantile regression within lavaan's growth modeling framework?
